title: The A/B Test on One Page
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A left-to-right flow of the whole A/B test: a pool of students is randomly assigned to the original or the improved version, both groups take the same pre-test and post-test, and learning gain is compared.

educational.topic: The whole design of a classroom A/B test on one page
learningObjectives: The learner will describe the parts of a classroom A/B test and explain why the two groups must differ only in the version.
prerequisites: Control group, treatment group, and random assignment from [Chapter 16](../../chapters/16-ab-testing-design/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What is the one difference between the groups?
Did both groups take the same tests?
commonMisconceptions: The control group gets no teaching
Volunteers make a fair treatment group
assessmentOpportunities: What does the control group receive?
What is the comparison at the end?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
